answer: Require breadth, not repeat wins. Standing stays valid only if an identity keeps passing challenges from several families — reasoning, fact, critique — so a farm tuned to one kind of question cannot coast on one skill. Real capability is an oasis supporting many kinds of life; a sybil pipeline supports one, and that single channel is what the ledger listens for. Farmed wallets become a whisper in one frequency, silent everywhere else. A raven flits between perches; a caged bird answers one call. Variety taxes specialization, and specialization is the farm’s only scalable trick.
